data.name: Super Biochar
data.description: Super Biochar is a South Norwalk, Connecticut-based climate-tech startup founded in 2025 that develops AI-designed biochar blends (SuperChar™) for soil remediation and carbon removal. The company pairs region-specific biochar formulations with independent soil diagnostics via Ward Laboratories and a mobile platform connecting soil testing, recommendations, and ordering, targeting brownfields, farms, vineyards and municipal lands.
